Lasooni Corn Palak, a thick, dhaba-style spinach gravy loaded with sweet corn and loads of garlic. It’s an easy recipe made with basic, homely ingredients, yet the flavour is absolutely incredible.
Even if you’re someone who doesn’t usually enjoy palak, I’m sure you’ll love this one! Enjoy it with hot laccha paratha or tandoori roti, especially on a rainy day. Do give this recipe a try. Happy Cooking!
